The '''Ranchlands''' was an area in the Southern Hemisphere of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Ranchlands were southwest of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], but east of [[Oxon City]].<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">Map on p20 of ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>
